title: Somebody
summary: SOMEBODY, noun [some and body.] 1. A person unknown or uncertain; a person indeterminate. Jesus said, somebody hath touched me Luke 8:46. We must draw in somebody that may stand 'Twixt us and danger.

inlines.v: SOMEBODY, noun [some and body.] 1. A person unknown or uncertain; a person indeterminate. Jesus said, somebody hath touched me Luke 8:46. We must draw in somebody that may stand 'Twixt us and danger. 2. A person of consideration. Before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody Acts 5:36.
